description: The engine of OpenCAD2D, a 2D CAD app that works like AutoCAD 2021, with no UI: DXF and DWG drawings opened as documents, drawn into 2D display lists, picked, and edited through AutoCAD's commands on a command line; AutoLISP and DCL, plot to PDF, command plugins and the Remote server. Its default f…

Drives a running OpenCAD2D from another program: finds the app, lists its drawings, reads and edits their entities and sends commands, the way a Tekla Open API program drives a running Tekla Structures.

Roslyn analyzers that hold C# 15 code to functional-programming rules: purity, immutability and totality inside types marked [Fprog.FunctionalCore], and complete matching over union types and closed classes.
Trace resolved .NET dependencies and inspect assembly metadata without loading target assemblies.

Subscriptions and one-time purchases for a Spine app: IAppPurchases with typed keys from the app's own enums, [RequiresPurchase] on a page or command, a paywall sheet, a Purchases section for the settings page and a test store. The store itself comes from an adapter package.

The RevenueCat store for Plugin.Maui.Spine.Purchases on iOS, Mac Catalyst and Android, on Plugin.RevenueCat: products and prices, purchases, restores, the user's purchases across devices with the Spine account, and a check of RevenueCat's entitlements against the app's [Grants].
V.44 compression and decompression for binary data, including stream support.
